pending.name: Have the figures and the reminders run by themselves, with no report to start.
pending.note: Seventeen of our yes ratings rest on x-openregister-calculations, x-openregister-notifications, appendOnly or x-property-rbac declared in lib/Settings/learniq_register.json, including the live coverage percentage and every certificate-expiry warning. Reading this repository shows the declaration, not that the installed Open Register executes it. Settling this needs a live instance, and until someone drives one those are readings of a declaration rather than of behaviour.

pending.name: Show an auditor that the evidence log itself cannot be rewritten.
pending.note: Nobody has checked any competitor for a tamper-evident evidence log. Moodle documents a per-user activity log, which is a different claim.

pending.name: Read one live percentage per rule, not a report you have to run.

pending.name: Export one signed file that holds the evidence and proves its own integrity.

pending.name: Give an ILIAS certificate an expiry and a recertification cycle.

pending.name: Issue badges to Open Badges 3.0 rather than 2.x.
pending.note: Moodle and ILIAS both ship Open Badges. Which version could not be settled from the pages read, and 3.0 is the claim that matters for wallets.
